title: Work Map recovery-chain registration and write-authority separation

phases.objective: Restore workflow registration while separating pull-request validation from all repository and Actions mutation authority.

e2e_journeys.actor: GitHub Actions workflow planner and governed Work Map operator
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A governed pull request plus a separate authorized Bootstrap activation
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: PR Generated Artifact Refresh evaluates the exact head read-only; the independent Bootstrap dispatches a workflow_dispatch-only Recovery; Recovery consumes one authorization marker and delegates to the sole writer; Integration publishes bounded exact-head repair evidence.
steps: Plan PR Generated Artifact Refresh without job-level runner.temp and without write permissions or mutation commands.
Allocate a runner and publish absolute refresh report paths through GITHUB_ENV.
Evaluate generated artifacts from the exact same-repository head without repository mutation.
Use the independent Bootstrap to validate actor, PR, marker, exact head, and behind_by=0 before dispatching Recovery.
Run Recovery only through workflow_dispatch after initializing its report directory from RUNNER_TEMP.
Consume the one-time marker in Recovery and dispatch the existing sole Work Map writer.
Run Work Map Integration with its repair root initialized after runner allocation.
assertions: The pull-request workflow contains no actions: write, issues: write, pull-requests: write, contents: write, git push, or Recovery dispatch.
Recovery exposes workflow_dispatch only and has no pull_request, pull_request_target, or issue_comment trigger.
No repaired workflow evaluates runner.temp in job-level env.
Integration remains contents: read and free of git push authority.
No Production, provider, deployment, database, SQL, Migration Apply, credential, protected-ref, force-push, or external-send authority is introduced.

phases.objective: Preserve exact-head validation, bounded evidence, one-time authorization consumption, sole-writer delegation, and Integration repair-candidate publication under separated workflow authority.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Static contracts and executable regressions for Bootstrap, Recovery, writer, and Integration
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Only the independently triggered Bootstrap may dispatch Recovery; only Recovery may consume the marker and dispatch the existing writer; pull-request validation and Integration remain read-only.
steps: Verify Bootstrap has no contents: write, marker consumption, direct writer dispatch, or git mutation.
Verify Bootstrap dispatches the Recovery workflow using the typed confirmation contract.
Verify Recovery is dispatch-only and validates one exact current same-repository PR.
Verify Recovery consumes one marker and delegates to the existing writer.
Verify PR validation and Integration retain read-only authority.
assertions: No pull-request-triggered workflow in the changed scope has write authority.
Recovery structured evidence declares protected_branch_mutation=false and force_push=false.
The sole writer remains the only Work Map content-writing workflow.
No secrets are included in reports or Artifacts.

phases.objective: Fail closed on pre-allocation runner context use, pull-request write authority, stale heads, missing authorization, or missing bounded path initialization.

e2e_journeys.actor: Repository Tool Lifecycle and Work Map integration gates
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Candidate change to any workflow or governance contract in the repaired chain
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The candidate is rejected before merge if a pull-request workflow regains mutation authority, Recovery gains an ambient trigger, runner.temp is evaluated before allocation, or evidence paths become unbounded.
steps: Evaluate changed workflows through Repository Tool Lifecycle Governance.
Reject pull-request workflows containing write permissions or mutation paths.
Load each repaired workflow and reject any runner.temp expression.
Require RUNNER_TEMP initialization through GITHUB_ENV after runner allocation.
Validate complete E2E journeys and bounded changed scope.
assertions: PULL_REQUEST_WRITE_WORKFLOW findings are absent from the final lifecycle report.
The regression fails if read-only jobs gain contents: write, Actions dispatch, issue mutation, PR mutation, or git push.
All implemented phases expose complete E2E journeys.

phases.objective: This repository workflow-registration repair has no provider canary authority.
This repair performs no Production action or deployment.
